blocks.text: Assistant Professor -Applied Science Department | English Language & Communication
Institute of Engineering & Technology (IET), Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya, Indore
Email: rsingh@ietdavv.edu.in

Accomplished academic with over 20 years of teaching experience, specializing in English language, communication, and the development of confident, articulate professionals. Adept at bridging the gap between technical knowledge and effective expression, I prepare engineering and management students to communicate their ideas with clarity, precision, and conviction in an increasingly globalized world. My teaching combines strong subject expertise with a genuine commitment to nurturing verbal and non-verbal communication, vocabulary enrichment, creative thinking, and self-confidence. I am dedicated to enhancing students' employability and global readiness by cultivating excellence in spoken and written English, fluency, and professional presentation skills.

To establish a centre of excellence for the English language—with a focus on TOEFL preparation, communicative fluency, and oratory confidence. I believe a strong command of colloquial and formal English not only strengthens communication and self-confidence but also significantly expands employment opportunities and global reach for every student.

rows.text: Walt Whitman: American Literature – A Study in the Light of Indian Philosophy

blocks.text: Doctoral Research

“The Poetry of Walt Whitman: A Study in the Light of Indian Philosophy.” An in-depth study of Walt Whitman—widely regarded as the greatest American poet of the nineteenth century and one of the major poets of the world—whose stature was firmly established with the publication of Leaves of Grass in 1855.
Transcendentalism in the Poetry of Walt Whitman.
Research paper on the use of positive words in fostering happiness — a tribute to the United Nations’ declaration of 20th March as World Happiness Day.
Visual Merchandising (article in progress).
